anchor.surface_text: Now assuming that the mode of employment used in s. 3 18  includes such questions as abolition of contract labour, the question would still be whether a provision which enables an industrial court to adjudicate on the question whether contract- tract labour should or should not be abolished is an unreasonable restriction on the employers right to carry on his trade.
